The Seller / Instagram Page Administrator,

SUBJECT: DEMAND FOR FULL REFUND OF RS 8000 FOR NON-DELIVERY OF GOODS

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to bring to your immediate notice that on 2026-11-01, I purchased shoes from your Instagram page and made a payment of Rs 8000 via UPI. 

To date, I have never received the shoes, and instead of fulfilling the order, you have blocked my account and failed to respond. Taking money without delivering goods amounts to an unfair trade practice and breach of contract, requiring a full refund under applicable laws.

Therefore, I hereby demand that you immediately refund the full amount of Rs 8000 to my UPI ID/bank account within 7 days of receiving this notice. Failing this, I will be constrained to initiate formal legal proceedings, including filing a consumer complaint and a cybercrime fraud report against you.

Sincerely,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]
[DATE]
